headline: Sensex surges 700 points with Nifty above 25,700 as Indian markets trade strong

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex surged 700 points and Nifty traded above 25,700 during the trading session.
SpiceJet announced a ₹5,500 crore fundraise to help revive its airline operations.
Urban Company raised ₹2,500 crore via QIP, drawing over ₹15,000 crore in demand.
The Oil Ministry assured petrol pump dealers it is looking into a dealer margin hike.
whatHappening: Indian equities saw broad gains led by strong market momentum.
Pristine Logistics & Infraprojects received SEBI's approval to launch its IPO.
SatSure aims to raise ₹200 crore in Series B funding to scale AI and satellite capabilities.
A Bank of Baroda manager was arrested for allegedly seeking a bribery amount to sanction a loan.
summary: Indian markets witnessed significant upside with Sensex jumping 700 points and Nifty holding above 25,700. Notable corporate moves included SpiceJet raising ₹5,500 crore and Urban Company launching a heavily oversubscribed QIP. Pristine Logistics also secured SEBI approval for its upcoming IPO.
